relations: A thin vertical dark line descends into the white mass, progressively dividing it into two rounded lobes.
The descending line triggers brownish fibrous strands to emerge at the interface between the white mass and dark liquid.
Small dark specks on the white surface shift slightly as the vertical line extends downward through the mass.
The dark-liquid level, wall droplets, left-side highlight, and background remain essentially unchanged throughout the static framing.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a transparent cylindrical container resting on a flat surface against a dark, blurred background. Inside, an opaque dark liquid fills the lower portion, topped by a jagged surface where a white fluffy mass sits, while water droplets cling to the inner walls and a rounded bright reflection remains near the lower left. A thin vertical dark line appears near the top center and progressively extends downward into the white mass. As it descends, the broad white mass appears divided into two rounded lobes around the line. Brownish fibrous strands emerge and persist at the interface between the white mass and the dark liquid near the center. Small dark specks on the white surface shift slightly during this motion. The dark-liquid level, the wall droplets, the left-side highlight, and the background remain essentially unchanged throughout. The framing stays static, holding the same view of the container with the line remaining visible.
